question: What does the Game Dashboard include?
answer: The Game Dashboard shows head-to-head detail for one game. It includes Player Stats (with a Category dropdown for stat types), Team Stats in a side-by-side comparison for both teams, Rosters for both teams (with a Show dropdown for starters vs full roster), and Play-by-Play of every action in the match.

question: What can Visualize Data do?
answer: Visualize Data adds charts to search results. After a search, click Visualize Data near the results table to open a chart for your query and period (game or season). It is available on Search Result Screens when at least one row is returned. Supported query types include Simple, Complex, Records, Last Time When, and Streaks. Simple queries show a horizontal bar chart of the top 10 players who met the condition most often. Complex queries use a scatter plot for the top 10 who met both conditions most frequently. Record queries use a line chart of the first 10 result rows, centering each player's record game with up to three games before and after. Last Time When plots unique players from the results, up to 10 of their games. Run a search, click Visualize Data on the top right of the table, then close the panel to return to the table.

question: What are Season Highs on the Team Dashboard?
answer: Season Highs on the Team Dashboard shows the highest value the team achieved for each statistic in a season, plus the game date it was recorded. Click SEASON HIGHS in the header. Filter by Season, Category, and Substat. The table lists Stat Name, Value, and Game Date. Use the dropdowns to filter, click x to clear, and click column headers to sort.

question: How do I export report records?
answer: Run your search on the Athlyte Search Dashboard. On the results page, click Export at the top right of the table. The system generates a file of your current results as an Excel (.xlsx) download to your default download folder, including the rows visible in the table with any filters applied.

question: What filters can I apply to search results?
answer: Athlyte Search includes sidebar filters to refine results. They apply to all query types except Streaks. Available filters include Results (match result), Date (custom date range by match date), Name (specific player), and Period Type (time period within a game). For Season queries, the panel also shows Position and Classes.

question: What filters can I apply to search results?
answer: Use the sidebar to refine results without retyping your query. These filters apply to all query types except Streaks: Opponent and Conference, Game Result (Wins or Losses), Game Type (Regular Season vs Post-season), Date Range, Player Metadata (Name, Position, or Class year), and Period Type (such as first half or overtime). You can also add qualifiers in the search text for team, opponent, conference, division, player name, class, position, game result, and game type. On Team result screens, the Position filter is hidden.

question: What filters can I apply to search results?

question: What is Athlyte Query Language (AQL)?
answer: Athlyte Query Language (AQL) is the structured format Athlyte Search uses after your natural language query is transformed so a program or database can fetch the right data. Standard fields include query_type, entity, qualifiers, stat_period, conditions, streak_len, periods, and period_type. Example: "The highest punt returns yards accomplished during a season" maps to query_type max, entity player, stat_period season, and conditions s_punt_returns_yards.
